criteria.text: Add authenticated POST `/live-artifacts/:id/capabilities/pco.services.read`, always-on hosted API, mounted narrowly. Pre-route index has no consumers; createApp prior impact LOW.

Caller must currently read artifact under AV02 private/shared/org rules AND artifact must declare exact `pco.services.read`; otherwise non-disclosing 404 for inaccessible artifact, 403 `capability_not_declared` for accessible undeclared. Soft-deleted accessible artifact returns path-free 410. No owner-only restriction: collaborators/org viewers use their own identity/integration.

Request schema is a closed allowlist for Worship Calendar service reads only: operations `list_service_types`, `list_plans`, `list_plan_items` (and `list_needed_positions` only if required by fixture/current service); typed IDs, plans filter future/past only. Reject unknown operation/keys, URLs, headers, methods, credentials, body passthrough, write operations, oversized inputs. No arbitrary proxy.
criteria.evidence: Oversized (>1 MiB) raw request injects bearer/token markers, raw-body marker, /state/, /bundles/, worktree path, stack/newline-at text, and artifact-internal text. The real HTTP response and captured logger.error calls exclude every marker; the controlled PCO fixture receives zero calls.

criteria.text: Resolve current authenticated user's PCO account via existing `IntegrationsService.ensureFreshPlanningCenterAccount`; call existing `PlanningCenterService` read methods. Never expose/log access/refresh tokens/account internals. Different users use own connection; missing/disconnected returns existing safe integration-required error; PCO permission denial retains safe machine code.
criteria.evidence: The live-only PCO read-base override table explicitly rejects http://[::1]:4199. This is a deliberate fail-closed test seam because URL.hostname normalizes it to [::1] while the explicit allowlist has ::1; IPv4/localhost fixtures remain supported.

criteria.text: Response is a path/token/header-free allowlisted projection sufficient for Worship Calendar (service type/plan/item IDs, titles, dates/times, sequence/description fields that existing service returns). Do not blindly return upstream JSON if it includes links/meta/credentials; define minimum projection based on actual types. Preserve external/untrusted data classification for later bridge.

Implement the smallest endpoint-local in-memory fixed-window limiter keyed `userId:artifactId`, 30 requests/minute, opportunistic pruning; 429 safe response/retryAfter. Ponytail comment: single-process Synology assumption; replace with shared store only if multi-instance deployment.
criteria.evidence: Injected clock proves first 429 at the fixed-window start returns integer retryAfter 60 and at +59.001 seconds returns 1; every asserted retryAfter is an integer in [1, 60], with no wall timer.

criteria.text: Tests: auth, accessibility matrix, declared/undeclared, user-specific account resolution, each operation and validation, no write/arbitrary URL, projection/token/path/log non-disclosure, PCO 403/disconnected, rate limit, soft delete.
criteria.evidence: Captured logger.info audit records have exactly actorUserId, artifactId, at, operation, outcome and expected values for success, accessible undeclared 403, accessible soft-deleted 410, and limiter 429. Temporary removal of either the 410 or 429 audit call fails this assertion.

criteria.text: Live sandbox behavioral E2E through real API surface proves connected-path operation using controlled external fixture/test account without production PCO mutation, plus undeclared and cross-user identity behavior. Never use production credentials. If safe connected-path cannot be provisioned, return NEEDS_CONTEXT rather than marking pass.
Scope: no Flutter/WebView/bridge/MCP/scheduler/background sync/state mutation. Manual/sync-on-open later calls this endpoint; endpoint itself only returns PCO data.
criteria.evidence: Explicit scope scan of the full changeset (tracked + untracked). Changed files are confined to apps/api_server/src (capability controller, route mount, PCO read base URL, three test files) plus docs/ai; grep for desktop_flutter|apps/mobile|apps/web|apps/electron|mcp_server|opencode_fork|*.dart|webview|bridge over the changeset returns no matches. No scheduler/cron/setInterval/background-sync/MCP tool registration is added; the only setTimeout in the diff is a 25 ms log-flush wait inside the live E2E test. The capability handler performs no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE and calls only repo.find, repo.canRead, IntegrationsService.ensureFreshPlanningCenterAccount, and the three read-only PlanningCenterService list methods — no PCO write path (sendJson/updatePlanItem) is reachable from it. The only state write anywhere on the path is the pre-existing OAuth token refresh inside ensureFreshPlanningCenterAccount, which c4 requires.
